mapper.sql: n.id, n.notification_id, n.user_id, n.scope, n.seq, n.sender_id, n.type, n.title, n.content, n.ref_type, n.ref_id, n.broadcast_msg_id, n.dedup_key, n.create_time, n.update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_seq (user_id, scope, seq, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scope}, 1, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE seq = seq + 1, update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO notification_read (user_id, scope, last_read_seq, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{scope}, #{lastReadSeq}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_read_seq = GREATEST(last_read_seq, VALUES(last_read_seq)), update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO notification (notification_id, user_id, scope, seq, sender_id, type, title, content, ref_type, ref_id, broadcast_msg_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{userId}, #{scope}, #{seq}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{broadcastMsgId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT IGNORE INTO notification (notification_id, user_id, scope, seq, sender_id, type, title, content, ref_type, ref_id, dedup_key, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{userId}, #{scope}, #{seq}, #{senderId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{dedupKey}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notification WHERE broadcast_msg_id = #{msgId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM notification WHERE dedup_key = #{dedupKey} LIMIT 1
